item.text: I’ll inspect the affected test, make a test-only refactor that preserves its stubbing behavior, then compile/run its focused Maven test if the module setup permits.

The test now creates and restubs `Directory` mocks through two small helpers, so the `getAllInvokers()` setup is centralized while all assertions and test flow remain untouched. I’m running the focused module test next.

The source diff is clean. The Maven wrapper could not bootstrap because its download connection failed before Maven started; I’ll check whether a system Maven installation can run the same focused test.
